options: Use approved current data, verify configuration applicability, record exact action in technical records, and defer release until all required checks are complete.
Proceed based on memory if the system appears to operate normally and complete paperwork later.
Use equivalent practices without confirming approved data because they worked on similar aircraft.
Release the aircraft first to avoid delay, then schedule document corrections at next check.
correctAnswer: Use approved current data, verify configuration applicability, record exact action in technical records, and defer release until all required checks are complete.
explanation: Best-answer logic: regulatory compliance and airworthiness require approved data, applicability validation, complete technical record entry, and required independent/functional checks before maintenance release. Reference points: AC 43.13-1B Acceptable Methods, plus organization MPM and applicable AMM/SRM procedures.
